**Severity:** error · **Area:** Imports / helpers / route modules (`RV3xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
{chain} (server-only), rendered by {routes} (client-navigated page route[s])
```

```text
{chain} (server-only), rendered by the layout of every page under {path} (client-rendered on navigation and resume)
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Pass the data to the component as props (inlined at build time, or read in the page's `load(…)`), keep server-only modules out of components, or make the page a document route with `import "@rivetjs/router/server-only"` in the page module. Layouts and error pages cannot be document routes: read the data in their `load(…)`. `rivetRouter({ serverOnly: { reach: "warn" } })` turns the page case into a warning (those pages render as document routes).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
// src/components/Card.tsx
import { rows } from "../lib/rows.server.ts";
export const Card = () => <p>{rows.length}</p>;
```

```tsx prefer
// src/components/Card.tsx
export const Card = (props: { count: number }) => <p>{props.count}</p>;
// src/routes/index.tsx: read rows.server.ts in load(…), render <Card count={…} />
```

## When it is reported

Router build (`@rivetjs/router/vite`, configResolved graph scan); TS-side text (not Rust). Server-only = `@rivetjs/router/server-only` marker, `*.server.*` files, `rivetRouter({ serverOnly })` / `rivet({ serverOnly })` patterns, plugin-declared ids (`api.rivetServerOnly`). Dev: overlay + terminal on page load. Pages that reach one only through their own module / non-component helpers become document routes instead (no diagnostic).
